skill.name: developer-experience
skill.description: Developer Experience specialist for project setup, onboarding guides, workflow automation, and tooling improvements.
skill.summary: Improve developer setup, feedback loops, and team workflows with practical tooling guidance.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples and onboarding templates, including code fences, sample setup scripts, and .env.example copy instructions. The only confirmed issue is guidance to modify persistent shell profile files, which is legitimate developer tooling advice but requires explicit consent and backup handling.

remediation.suggestion: Ask before changing ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc, show the exact alias lines, create a backup, and prefer project-local scripts when possible.

content.value_statement: Developer setup often becomes slow, inconsistent, and hard to maintain. This skill helps analyze friction, create setup guidance, and improve tooling for faster feedback.
actual_capabilities: Reviews project setup steps and suggests faster onboarding flows.
Drafts setup scripts, Makefile tasks, npm scripts, and shell aliases.
Creates developer onboarding guide templates with prerequisites and verification steps.
Recommends IDE settings, linting, formatting, and git hook improvements.
Identifies repetitive development tasks that can be automated.
Defines practical DX success metrics such as setup time and feedback speed.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, but generated commands still need review before use.
It does not validate every project dependency or environment requirement automatically.
It cannot guarantee that setup scripts work across all operating systems.
It may need repository context to give accurate workflow recommendations.

use_cases.title: Speed Up New Project Setup
use_cases.description: Create a clear setup flow with prerequisites, installation steps, environment checks, and verification commands.

use_cases.title: Standardize Daily Development Tasks
use_cases.description: Turn repeated commands into scripts, Makefile targets, aliases, and documented workflows that teams can reuse.

use_cases.title: Improve Team Onboarding Documentation
use_cases.description: Build an onboarding guide that explains tools, local setup, project structure, and first-week milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Setup Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project setup process and identify the top five sources of friction for a new developer.

prompt_templates.title: Create Onboarding Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a developer onboarding guide for this repository with prerequisites, setup steps, verification checks, and troubleshooting notes.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Common Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the repeated development commands in this project and propose scripts, aliases, or Makefile tasks that reduce manual work.

prompt_templates.title: Design a DX Improvement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the developer workflow for setup time, test feedback, code quality checks, local services, and documentation. Produce a prioritized improvement plan.

output_examples.input: Optimize the setup process for this project.
output: A short list of setup blockers, such as missing prerequisites and unclear environment steps.
A proposed one-command setup flow with validation checks and a final success message.
Documentation updates that explain how to start the app and verify the local environment.

output_examples.input: Create shortcuts for common development tasks.
output: A grouped set of task names for development, testing, formatting, database setup, and cleanup.
Notes on where each shortcut should live and when team approval is needed.
A recommendation to document every shortcut in the project README.
A day-by-day onboarding outline covering setup, codebase orientation, workflow practice, and first contribution.
A checklist for required access, local services, and verification steps.
A troubleshooting section for common dependency, port, and environment issues.

best_practices: Review generated commands before running them, especially commands that install packages or change files.
Keep setup scripts idempotent so developers can rerun them safely after partial failures.
Document each workflow shortcut near the project code so the whole team can maintain it.
anti_patterns: Do not add shell profile changes without user approval and a clear rollback path.
Do not hide complex setup requirements behind a script without explaining what it changes.
Do not optimize only for one developer machine when the team uses multiple operating systems.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps improve project setup, onboarding, automation, tooling, and daily development workflows.

faq.question: Can it create setup scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft setup scripts and task shortcuts, but you should review commands before running them.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it improve existing documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can turn unclear setup notes into structured onboarding and troubleshooting guidance.

faq.question: Does it automatically change my shell configuration?
faq.answer: No. It may suggest aliases, but shell profile changes should require explicit user approval.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the repository structure, package scripts, setup instructions, known pain points, and target operating systems.
